courses.name: B.Sc. in Computer Science
aliases: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
courses.summary: A B.Sc. in Computer Science is a science-faculty bachelor's degree in the theory and practice of computing. The curriculum covers programming, data structures and algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer architecture, operating systems, databases, networks and software engineering, with electives in artificial intelligence, data science, cyber security or graphics. It differs from a B.E./B.Tech by placing more weight on mathematics and computing theory and less on engineering design. Programmes last three or four years and lead to software, data and IT roles or to master's study.
courses.metaTitle: B.Sc. Computer Science Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.Sc. Computer Science degrees open to international students: curriculum, electives, entry subjects, duration, tuition and intakes.

courses.name: B.Sc. in Data Science
aliases: Bachelor of Science in Data Science
courses.summary: Bachelor of Science programmes in Data Science combine computing, mathematics, statistics and the analysis of data. Study commonly includes programming, databases, probability, statistical modelling and machine learning, with practical projects. Award structure, duration and admission subjects vary by university.
courses.metaTitle: B.Sc. Data Science Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.Sc. Data Science degrees by duration, mathematics prerequisites, teaching language, tuition status, practical study and international entry.

courses.name: Master of Commerce
courses.summary: The Master of Commerce is a two-year postgraduate degree in commerce, usually open to graduates who hold a B.Com., BBA or a related business degree. Study builds on undergraduate accounting and finance with advanced financial and management accounting, corporate finance, financial markets and investment analysis, taxation, business research methods and economics, and many programmes offer a specialisation such as finance, accounting or banking. Assessment typically includes a research project or dissertation. Graduates often work in accounting, finance and banking roles, prepare for professional accountancy examinations, or continue to doctoral study and teaching.
courses.metaDescription: Compare M.Com programmes by official award, academic eligibility, teaching language, duration, university and tuition fees.

courses.name: M.Sc. in Biological Sciences
courses.summary: Biological sciences master’s programmes provide advanced academic study of living systems and specialist fields within biology. Curricula may combine coursework, laboratory learning, research methods, practical exposure and a project or dissertation. Compare qualifying bachelor’s subjects, marks, teaching language, specialisation, study location, assessment and complete costs.
courses.metaTitle: M.Sc. Biological Sciences: Entry and Fees

courses.name: M.Sc. in Biotechnology
courses.summary: The Students Traffic catalogue category for postgraduate science-track biotechnology degrees. Programmes deepen molecular biology, genetic engineering, immunology, bioprocess technology and bioinformatics, usually with a research dissertation. Curriculum, approvals, admission route and fees are set by each awarding university, so the programme record should drive a shortlist decision.
courses.metaDescription: Compare M.Sc. Biotechnology programmes by entry requirements, teaching language, duration, academic structure, study location and complete fees.

courses.name: M.Sc. in Chemistry
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers postgraduate Master of Science degrees in chemistry, usually two years after a science bachelor's degree with chemistry. Programmes typically advance organic, inorganic, physical and analytical chemistry with spectroscopy and instrumentation, supported by extensive laboratory work, seminars and a research project or dissertation.

universities.summary: Thiruvalluvar University is a public state university established in 2002 at Serkkadu, near Vellore. Its university departments offer science, language, commerce and economics degrees alongside research. Regular campus programmes have their own qualifications and fees; affiliated-college courses are separate choices.
universities.campusLifestyle: The university departments are based at Serkkadu, near Vellore. The campus brings together academic departments and library, sports and student services. Confirm the teaching site and actual language arrangement when choosing a programme.
universities.cityProfile: The university is at Serkkadu, near Vallimalai, outside Vellore city on the Ranipet–Chittoor route. Plan commuting or residential arrangements around the university campus rather than assuming a city-centre or affiliated-college teaching location.
universities.practicalExposure: The campus portfolio includes laboratory sciences, mathematics, computing, commerce and economics. Science regulations describe practical study and research/project work where prescribed, while subject requirements differ by degree. Confirm the actual curriculum and laboratory component for the selected award; an academic degree does not establish a professional licence or guaranteed placement.
universities.hostelOverview: The university publishes hostel facilities and a separate hostel application. Confirm room allocation, reporting arrangements, charges and availability before travelling; academic selection does not guarantee accommodation.
universities.dietarySupport: Ask about current mess arrangements, meal charges and any dietary requirements before accepting residential accommodation. No special-menu guarantee is established here.
universities.safetyOverview: The university publishes student-support resources and an Internal Committee. Confirm campus reporting, health and emergency arrangements when enrolling; no general safety guarantee is implied.
universities.studentSupport: University admission and eligibility verification are separate from government concession eligibility. Keep qualifying records and valid community/disability documents ready, and confirm scholarship reimbursement and personal payment requirements before budgeting.

faq.question: Where are these programmes taught?
faq.answer: These routes concern the university departments at Serkkadu near Vellore. Affiliated colleges and any extension-centre courses have separate teaching sites and applicable admission arrangements.

faq.question: What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: The subject route differs by programme. For example, Physics requires a Physics degree with Mathematics allied, while computing and life-science courses have their own accepted degree lists and any specified marks.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: The general postgraduate rule is English except language programmes. The supported Tamil award has a programme-specific Tamil instruction rule. The undergraduate regulation permits Tamil or English for core courses and the concerned language for language papers.

faq.question: Are these annual fee amounts?
faq.answer: The native quotes isolate tuition explicitly charged per annum in the published tariff. Other institutional annual charges, one-time payments, refundable deposits and hostel/mess costs are additional.

faq.question: Are concessions automatic?
faq.answer: No. The tariff gives conditional tuition reimbursement terms for eligible Tamil Nadu SC/ST and converted-Christian scholarship applicants, and disability-related concessions require prescribed proof. Confirm the actual payment and reimbursement process.

faq.question: Can another-university graduate apply?
faq.answer: The qualifying degree must satisfy the subject route and university equivalence acceptance. Other-university applicants may require the prescribed eligibility certificate before admission is confirmed.

faq.question: Can international applicants use the same rate?
faq.answer: Current overseas-category eligibility and fees are not established by the domestic route here. Confirm qualification acceptance, admission category and the applicable international tariff individually.

faq.question: When does the next intake begin?
faq.answer: Follow the next applicable university admission notice for application and reporting dates. An exact intake month or future opening is not asserted here.
